d: The Senior Manager - Guest Management Technologies will lead the design, delivery, and governance of enterprise-grade Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions across customer engagement, service, sales, field operations, digital channels, and contact center capabilities.

This role requires strong hands-on knowledge of both functional business processes and technical solution design across Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Sales, Field Service, Customer Voice, Customer Insights, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Contact Center solutions.
The role will act as a bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and delivery squads to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, integrated, and aligned with business objectives.
q: li
7-12 years of experience in CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, enterprise applications, or digital transformation roles, with strong exposure to both functional and technical delivery.
li
Proven experience leading Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations in complex enterprise environments.
li
Deep functional and technical understanding of Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Sales, Field Service, Customer Voice, Customer Insights, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Contact Center.
li
Strong knowledge of Dataverse, security roles, business units, data models, forms, views, workflows, business rules, dashboards, and solution management.
li
Experience with integrations using APIs, custom connectors, Azure services, middleware platforms, plugins, web resources, and Power Platform extensibility.
li
Ability to lead requirements gathering, process mapping, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, customization, testing, deployment, and support.
li
Strong understanding of customer service operations, sales processes, field service management, customer feedback, customer data platforms, digital portals, and omnichannel/contact center processes.
li
Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams, including functional consultants, developers, testers, architects, business analysts, and vendor teams.
li
Strong stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
li
Experience working in multi-vendor, consulting-led, or large-scale transformation environments is highly preferred.
li
Familiarity with Agile delivery, DevOps, ALM, environment strategy, release management, and governance for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
li

Relevant Microsoft certifications are an advantage, such as Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant, Sales Functional Consultant, Field Service Functional Consultant, Power Platform Functional Consultant, Power Platform Solution Architect, or Dynamics 365 Solution Architect.
p
Familiarity with governmental, giga-project, real estate, tourism, entertainment, or large enterprise ecosystems is a plus
r: li
Lead end-to-end delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform initiatives across functional and technical workstreams.
li
Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs, functional specifications, and technical architecture.
li

Manage solution design and configuration across Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Sales, Field Service, Customer Voice, Customer Insights, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Contact Center capabilities.
li
Provide techno-functional leadership across workshops, discovery sessions, process design, fit-gap analysis, backlog refinement, and solution validation.
li
Oversee configuration, customization, integration, data migration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support activities.
li
Define and govern solution architecture, ensuring alignment with Microsoft best practices, security standards, integration patterns, and enterprise architecture principles.
li
Lead the design of customer service, case management, sales lifecycle, field service operations, customer feedback, customer data, portals, automation, and omnichannel contact center processes.
li
Work closely with business owners, product teams, developers, architects, QA teams, and vendors to ensure high-quality delivery.
li
Review and validate technical designs, plugins, workflows, Power Automate flows, custom connectors, APIs, integrations, and Power Platform components.
li
Support data model design, Dataverse configuration, security roles, business rules, forms, views, dashboards, reports, and application lifecycle management.
li
Manage delivery plans, risks, dependencies, issue resolution, stakeholder expectations, and release readiness.
li
Promote reusability, standardization, automation, governance, and adoption of low-code/no-code capabilities across delivery teams.
li
Ensure solutions are secure, performant, maintainable, and compliant with organizational policies and Microsoft platform standards.
h
Key Outcomes Expected from This Role
li
Successful delivery of scalable Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions across customer engagement and operational domains.
li
Improved business process efficiency through automation, integration, and standardized platform capabilities.
li
Strong alignment between business requirements, solution design, and technical implementation.
li
Reduced delivery risk through effective governance, design assurance, testing, and release management.
li
Enhanced customer and employee experience across service, sales, field service, portals, surveys, insights, and contact center channels.
li
Improved collaboration and accountability between business, IT, vendors, Microsoft partners, and delivery teams.
li
Increased adoption of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform capabilities across the organization.
